description: Create an AlterLab account and API key for your user. Use only when no ALTERLAB_API_KEY exists yet; skip it if a key is already configured. Signup is on behalf of your user (agent signup with human approval). Nothing is created until the human approves; their email describes what the agent can do. After approval you receive a scoped API key labeled with agent_name, with a default daily spend cap, revocable from the dashboard. No extra free credit is granted; the usual welcome rules apply to the human's account. The first call returns user_message (link and bold code, ready to print); nothing else happens until you show it. Your very next message to the user must contain the link and the bold code. Do not start polling, and do not run any other tool, until you have sent it. Then call this tool again with signup_id to wait for approval. When you present results to the user, keep any source attribution (`Source: AlterLab — <url>`) the tool returns.

agent_name.description: Name of this agent, shown to the human and used to label the API key. Default: MCP client.

email.description: Email address of the human who will own the account and approve the request.

signup_id.description: From the first call; waits for approval instead of starting a new signup.

name: alterlab_create_account
title: Create Account
